what: Initial pre-flight Arm 1 Positive Control 1 requiring within-workbook Pearson r(mean(Fsk+VX-770), -mean(Inh172)) > 0.95 across all 11 FRT-WT groups before hypothesis evaluation.
why: Aborted prior to Arm 1/2 outcome evaluation: FRT-WT all-11-group r was 0.884189 because chronic ETI pre-treatment groups (siNS, ETI residual -14.14775; siCANX, ETI residual -5.965543) carry basal VX-770 current blocked by Inh172 beyond acute Fsk, whereas 9 non-ETI FRT-WT groups gave r = 0.993663 and pooled 22 groups gave r = 0.991056. Clarified done.md positive control before re-running.

what: Arm 1 (frt_ussing_sicanx_asymmetry): testing whether siCANX reduces FRT-F508del 661+445 Delta Isc (Arm 1a) AND reduces it proportionally more than FRT-WT DMSO (Arm 1b) at Bonferroni alpha = 0.025 under strict duplicate-column deduplication.
why: Both Arm 1a and Arm 1b failed Bonferroni gates: Arm 1a exact two-sided permutation p = 0.085714 (3/35 splits > 0.025, Welch p = 0.058231, despite -31.55% mean drop and bootstrap 97.5% CI [-0.632096, -0.100299]); Arm 1b DiD log-ratio = -0.054142 vs -27.74% WT DMSO drop gave one-sided stratified permutation p = 0.408714 and one-sided 97.5% upper CI = +0.224171 > 0. Standing: refuted.

what: Arm 2 (canx_ko_proteostasis_remodeling): testing whether >= 1 of 4 canonical proteostasis modules (folding, ups, autophagy_lysosome, trafficking) passes BH-FDR q < 0.05 in BOTH Drug paired |LFC(combo)|-|LFC(DMSO)| (4 tests) and Variants LFC enrichment (20 tests).
why: 0/4 canonical modules survived BH-FDR q < 0.05 in Drug (min q = 0.640625 for folding, raw p = 0.160156) and 0/20 module-variant pairs survived BH-FDR q < 0.05 in Variants (min q = 0.694575 for WT(-CX):folding raw p = 0.048141 and I1366N (-CX):trafficking raw p = 0.070789). Standing: refuted.
